label: The animation lane's H3 stack
description: The keyframe-animation rendering lane's engine (task 4 of the animation-authoring module): the stock H3 base the three tools ride (ref2va pruned int8 convrot — Set K's measured operating point) plus the three staged keyframe adapter LoRAs (h3_hero/h3_tween/h3_seq_step12000, /home/agent/models/loras/).
